content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"B2B billing and customer care software for telecom and pay-TV operators, unlike Gen's consumer security subscriptions."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Consumer mobile banking and cash advances for paycheck-to-paycheck workers, not security or identity protection subscriptions."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"B2B regulatory filing and proxy services for public companies and funds, a different business from consumer security."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise and government network security hardware and appliances sold through channels; shares a cybersecurity label but not the consumer business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly small business accounting, payroll and payments software, with tax as a core line; consumer personal finance is only a secondary part."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"B2B identity verification and mobile deposit capture for banks and fintechs, not consumer identity protection subscriptions."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise application development, data integration and infrastructure software sold to IT teams, unlike consumer security."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Carrier-grade IP communications and session border controllers for telecom providers, a B2B infrastructure business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Business cloud phone and contact center subscriptions for companies, not consumer security or identity protection."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise marketing and customer experience software for large brands, unrelated to consumer cyber safety."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Financial services back-office software and outsourced fund administration for asset managers and banks, not consumer products."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Physical cash transport, ATM services and security equipment for banks and retailers, with no consumer software subscriptions."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Owns consumer security software and privacy tools with overlapping consumer cyber safety products, though its revenue is mainly advertising from media brands."}]}
